# Vendored dependencies

- `oboe/`: Google Oboe 1.9.3, official source archive, Apache-2.0. Only the build files, include, src, cmake and license are retained. Archive SHA-256: `85225b2ded89d1b0bb4447d718284fb51757ca6e027cb328f3f229d289e0a5e3`.
- `nlohmann/json.hpp`: nlohmann/json v3.12.0, MIT. Source: <https://github.com/nlohmann/json>.
- `stb_image.h`: nothings/stb commit `5c205738c191bcb0abc65c4febfa9bd25ff35234`, MIT / public domain. Source: <https://github.com/nothings/stb>.

Source license headers are retained. Runtime license texts are copied into the application assets by `prepare-assets.py`.
